Smart Falcon didn't show up for 
training... Worried, I went looking for 
her, and—

...I spotted her happily walking out of 
the CD shop in front of the station.

"Smart Falcon apologized in an adorable 
way. However, that wasn't going to let her 
off the hook... I made sure to give her a 
thorough lecture on being more careful."
